title: CL: penny half-up rule and unchanged costing rounding exceptions
public_pr_body:
CL documents Rhys's normal-money penny rule, 0.135 -> 0.14, and adds 21 app regression cases plus a real PostgreSQL parity test. Fixed vectors cover ties that distinguish half-up from half-even, fractional lines, existing negative half-away behaviour and per-line VAT before summing. Database test uses actual numeric SELECTs after disposable-backend verification; no optional skip or schema/business writes.

Costing remains the deliberate half-to-even exception: no costing engine, rates or any of its 60 golden answers changed. The optional offline CC half-even helper mismatch stays explicit for review.

Exact head: d7d6ff9dbd915becdc096d1eb365e4a73b4ae21d. `npx vitest run tests/unit/money-rounding-rule.test.ts tests/unit/money-decimal.test.ts`: 29 passed, zero failed/skipped. Changed-test ESLint and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass. `npx vitest run -c vitest.db.config.ts tests/db/money-rounding-parity.test.ts`: 1 failed/0 skipped at missing TEST_SUPABASE_URL; no SQL parity query ran. Current Docker socket permission denied. Local source/dependency limits are documented in tests/ROUNDING-RULE.md; real parity remains NOT TESTED. CI run 41826433316 was pending when recorded; recheck it.

Retains the updated CJ/CG/CH stack. No main merge, Ready label or production SQL. Claude Code handover: tests/HANDOVER-BUILDER-3.md on #271.

- [x] Rule, protected costing exception, app tests and real DB parity test
- [ ] Run parity on verified disposable backend, final-head CI and independent review
